BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc announced that between July 13 and July 17, 2026, it repurchased 492,000 ordinary shares as part of its $250 million share buyback program. The company intends to cancel these shares, and following this, the total number of issued shares will be 211,204,519, with the total voting rights remaining the same. Since the program's inception on February 26, 2026, Hikma has bought back a total of 10,681,934 ordinary shares for £146,611,496.31. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 20 July 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 13 July 2026 to 17 July 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 10,681,934 ordinary shares at a total cost of £146,611,496.31. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 211,204,519 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 211,204,519.
